profile.headline: Software Engineer at CACI International Inc

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Design and develop ASP.NET Core RESTful APIs using CQRS/HATEOAS patterns with MediatR, implementing command and query handlers to decouple controllers from business logic and support scalable backend services consumed by Angular and TypeScript applications.
	•	Implement and optimize data access layers using NHibernate ORM, writing complex queries and stored procedures in SQL Server and PostgreSQL to support high-volume data processing and reporting.
	•	Develop and maintain C# business logic components for an ASP.NET MVC Army Reserve retirement management system.
	•	Collaborate with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot production issues, improve system performance, and deliver new application features.
